listings.description: Beautifully updated and move in ready! Main level boasts open space with cozy family room with fireplace and built in shelving, separate dining room, and updated kitchen with stainless appliances and custom island. Kitchen walks out to freshly stained and oversized deck backing to large flat back yard, common space, and trees. This home has a much desired two car garage entering into laundry/mud room. Upper level had three spacious bedrooms with large closets and two updated baths. Lower level is fully finished with a large rec room, bonus room being used as a 4th bedroom, and large storage and utility area. Walk up stairs take you from the rec room to the beautiful private back yard. Fresh paint and new lighting throughout. Enjoy close proximity to schools, shopping, community pool and more. ROUGH IN FOR A FULL BATH IN THE BASEMENT. Excellent location and a move in ready home! Hurry!

Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in Leesburg's sought-after Tavistock Farms, this beautiful brick-front colonial offers spacious living, timeless charm, and an exceptional backyard setting on approximately one-third of an acre backing to common ground. With five bedrooms, three-and-a-half baths, generous indoor and outdoor living spaces, and a traditional floor plan designed for everyday comfort and entertaining, this is a home with room to truly make your own. A welcoming two-story foyer with hardwood flooring opens to formal living and dining rooms accented by crown molding, while a private study with French doors provides a quiet space to work or unwind. At the heart of the home, the kitchen features granite countertops, a center island, stainless steel appliances, gas cooking, under-cabinet lighting, and an adjoining breakfast room. The kitchen opens to an expansive family room with soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a cozy gas fireplace. Together, these spaces create a comfortable setting for everything from quiet evenings at home to gatherings with friends and family. Just beyond the Kitchen, a covered, screened porch opens to a spacious deck with stairs leading to a patio and the fenced backyard. Framed by mature trees and backing to common area, this beautifully established outdoor space offers exceptional privacy and room for entertaining, gardening, recreation, or simply relaxing outdoors. Upstairs, double doors welcome you into the spacious primary suite, where the sitting room leads up a few steps to the elevated sleeping area. Two walk-in closets and a private en suite bath with dual vanities, a soaking tub, separate shower, and updated flooring and plumbing fixtures complete the suite. Three additional bedrooms, a refreshed full hall bath, and a conveniently located laundry closet complete the upper level. The finished walkout lower level offers a generous recreation room with built-in bookcases and direct access to the backyard. A fifth bedroom with a walk-in closet, along with a newly added full bathroom, provides flexible space for overnight guests, a home office, or additional living accommodations. Two unfinished storage rooms offer abundant space for storage and hobbies. Recent improvements include a new lower-level full bathroom, updated LVP flooring in the upper-level bathrooms, refreshed primary bathroom plumbing fixtures, a new dishwasher, and freshly power washed and stained deck (2026). Additional updates include a water heater (2023), roof replacement (2018), and upper-level HVAC replacement (2016). A two-car garage with overhead storage and hardwired Ethernet connections throughout the home add convenience and functionality. Life in Tavistock Farms offers a wonderful balance of community, recreation, and convenience. Residents enjoy a swimming pool - home of the Tavistock Tsunamis swim team, tennis courts, walking trails, tot lots, a stocked catch-and-release fishing pond, and a community farmhouse available for private events. Neighborhood celebrations and seasonal traditions, including holiday gatherings and community events, create opportunities to connect with neighbors throughout the year. Ideally located near Village at Leesburg and Compass Creek, this home offers easy access to Wegmans, restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, movie theatre, bowling lanes, and everyday essentials. Historic Downtown Leesburg is less than three miles away, with its charming boutiques, locally loved restaurants, and year-round events. With its generous living spaces, peaceful cul-de-sac location, beautiful backyard, and the welcoming atmosphere of Tavistock Farms, this is a place to settle in, make memories, and feel at home for years to come. Welcome home!

Situated on a desirable corner lot with a large backyard and oversized garage, this is far more than a renovation. This home is not just a property; it's a place where memories are made. Experience the warmth and charm of Exeter, where comfort meets community. Don't miss the opportunity to make this inviting residence your own!

Mature trees, established landscaping, a renovated brick walkway, and a lovely fenced backyard add to the home's timeless appeal. Imagine morning strolls to your favorite coffee shop, afternoons exploring downtown boutiques, and evenings enjoying Leesburg's wonderful restaurants. With seasonal festivals, farmers markets, and a vibrant community just a short walk away, this special location offers an exceptional way of life. A rare opportunity to enjoy the character of an established Leesburg neighborhood, the simplicity of main-level living, and the charm of Historic Downtown just beyond your doorstep.

Opportunity knocks!! Location, location, location! Super close and down the street (0.8 miles) to the new Veteran's Park at Balls Bluff! This park offers Potomac River access, walking trails and parking. Since purchasing this home in late 2024, the homeowners have made a significant investment in its comfort, efficiency, and appearance-thoughtfully improving the property with the intention of enjoying it for years to come. The result is a beautifully refreshed Lockmeade model offering nearly 3,300 finished square feet on three levels, 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a large, level, fenced backyard at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. Among the most impressive improvements is the completely reimagined primary bath, a substantial renovation featuring a custom shower, upgraded vanities and fixtures, and enhanced electrical features. The home has also benefited from extensive interior and exterior painting, new flooring and carpet throughout the main and upper levels, replacement of all upper-level windows plus four additional windows, and significant HVAC and insulation improvements. The dramatic family room features vaulted ceilings, a wall of windows, recessed LED lighting, and a custom-built fireplace. Lighting throughout the home has been extensively upgraded with new fixtures, ceiling fans, recessed LEDs, dimmers, and motion-sensor exterior lighting. The hall bath and laundry room have also been renovated, with the laundry room receiving a new floor drain and washer and dryer. The finished lower level provides wonderful flexibility with recreation and media space, a full bath, abundant storage, and a dedicated gym enhanced with water and electrical improvements. Additional investments include radon mitigation, upgraded blinds throughout, exterior electrical outlets, deck lighting and power, a new deck landing, attic and garage insulation, exterior repairs and maintenance, landscaping enhancements, and more. Outside, enjoy a large, level fully fenced back yard, enhanced deck and three-season sunroom-ideal spaces for relaxing, entertaining, or play. These homeowners have truly cared for this property, addressing both the improvements you can see and many of the important items you cannot. Location is another standout. Potomac Crossing is ideally situated near historic downtown Leesburg and the natural beauty and walking trails of Ball's Bluff Battlefield Regional Park, while everyday conveniences are just minutes away. Enjoy easy access to Leesburg Premium Outlets, Target, Costco, restaurants, shopping and entertainment-offering a wonderful combination of neighborhood living, outdoor recreation and day-to-day convenience. Potomac Crossing offers a community pool, playgrounds, walking trails, and tennis. Video and audio recording onsite**

Some homes invite you to slow down. To linger over morning coffee, gather around the table a little longer, and enjoy the quiet beauty of life in the countryside. Welcome to 43581 Lost Corner Road, where thoughtful design, timeless materials, and 4.53 acres of open land come together to create something truly special. Located within Lucketts, this four-sided brick rambler has been beautifully reimagined with more than $200,000 in renovations across both levels. Every detail feels considered, blending the character of a 1974 home with the warmth and ease of modern living. At the heart of the home, a stunning kitchen pairs richly veined Shadow Brown marble countertops with slim Shaker white oak cabinetry, thoughtfully integrated appliance garages, Roman Plaster finished hood, unlacquered-look brass details, and a complete suite of Thermador appliances, including an induction cooktop and double ovens. Vintage-inspired lighting and beautifully patinated brass accents lend a collected, lived-in elegance that feels anything but ordinary. The adjoining living room is wrapped in vertical shiplap, with a classic brick fireplace and a reclaimed mantel sourced from a historic Middleburg home-a meaningful nod to the region's architectural heritage. In the dining room and hallway, Sandberg's Raphael wallpaper in soft green brings the outdoors in, adding another layer of texture and quiet sophistication. All four bedrooms are conveniently located on the main level, including a primary bedroom with an ensuite half bath. A beautifully appointed hall bath serves the additional bedrooms, while charming details like board-and-batten millwork and patterned wallpaper give each space its own personality. Downstairs, the fully renovated lower level offers an entirely new way to live, with generous recreation space, updated flooring, a beautifully finished full bath, and a spacious bonus room ideal for guests, a home office, creative studio, or whatever this season of life calls for. With approximately 2,745 finished square feet across both levels, there's room to gather, retreat, and make the space your own. And then there's the land. Set on 4.53 acres of mostly level countryside with no HOA, the possibilities feel wonderfully open. A fenced garden with raised beds and pea gravel pathways is ready for vegetables, cut flowers, and afternoons spent with your hands in the soil. A welcoming front porch, expansive Trex deck add to the property's everyday charm and versatility. Imagine fresh eggs in the morning, children exploring the yard, garden harvests on the kitchen counter, and summer evenings spent listening to cicadas beneath a sky full of stars. It's a place for slower mornings, meaningful traditions, and the simple pleasure of having room to breathe. All of this, just minutes from the charm of Lucketts, the natural beauty of the Potomac River, and the shops and restaurants of Leesburg, with convenient access to Frederick County, Maryland. Beautifully renovated. Rich in character. Rooted in the countryside. Welcome home to Lost Corner Road.
